meta.styleGuide: Flat vector icon illustration on a pure white background. Bold, clean outlines, minimal color blocks, no 3D shading, no gradients, no shadows, no realistic textures. Modern flat-design style like a polished mobile-app icon or pictogram. Limited soft pastel palette: aqua #7DD3F0, soft green #95D9B6, warm yellow #FCD37A, soft coral #FFB0A8, soft blue #B5C9E8, deep coral #E55934 (warning), deep green #58CC02 (success), white, soft gray #E8EEF5. Each image shows ONE clear, recognizable object or scene. No people, no children, no characters, no faces, no hands with fingers (hands must be simple mitten silhouettes). No text, no labels, no words. CRITICAL: NO checkmarks, NO X marks, NO warning circles, NO evaluation symbols, NO badges, NO thumbs-up, NO stars, NO plus or minus signs anywhere in any image. The UI overlays the verdict (correct/wrong) on top, so the images must stay neutral. Subject centered, generous padding around it, square or 16:9 framing.
